t: This is Gordon Square, a public park square in Bloomsbury. It is part of the Bedford Estate and was designed as a pair with nearby Tavistock Square. The University of London owns it today. The name comes from Georgiana Russell, Duchess of Bedford, born Lady Georgiana Gordon, a patron of the arts. Two people died here: Brandon Thomas, who wrote the farce Charley's Aunt, and Sir Percival David, whose collection of Chinese ceramics is regarded as the world's most important outside the palace collections of China and Taiwan.
